stage: POLARIS STAGE 8.16A — CAUSAL NWP UNCERTAINTY / CLOUD-STATE CONFIDENCE FEASIBILITY AUDIT
scientific_conclusion_statement: The audited MEPS uncertainty representations identify provisionally feasible, materially distinct candidate signals (specifically multi-layer cloud fraction spread sigma_low_cloud, condensate path spread sigma_LWP, and internal physical inconsistency Phi_inconsist). However, Stage 8.16B is NOT AUTHORIZED in this feasibility stage.

candidate_signals_audited.name: Total Cloud Area Fraction Member Disagreement (sigma_cloud_frac)
candidate_signals_audited.comparison_stage_6_1: Shares underlying variance driver with Stage 6.1 meps_std_SW_IN.

candidate_signals_audited.family: A. Member Disagreement in Cloud State
candidate_signals_audited.name: Multi-Layer Cloud Fraction Member Disagreement (sigma_low_cloud, sigma_mid_cloud, sigma_high_cloud)

candidate_signals_audited.name: Vertical Cloud Boundary Member Disagreement (sigma_Zbase, sigma_Ztop)
